test.command: uvx ruff check -q . && uvx ruff format --check -q . && git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 shellcheck -S warning && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --silent; } && npm run --silent lint:js && node --test scripts/*.test.js && for t in skills/*/scripts/*.test.sh skills/*/scripts/lib/*.test.sh skills/*/scripts/adapters/*.test.sh scripts/*.test.sh; do [ -e "$t" ] || continue; bash "$t" || exit 1; done && for t in skills/*/scripts/test_*.py; do [ -e "$t" ] || continue; python3 "$t" || exit 1; done
